newsitem.title: INDIA: Four India paramilitary soldiers killed in ambush.
newsitem.headline: Four India paramilitary soldiers killed in ambush.

text.p: Four paramilitary soldiers were killed and 10 injured on Tuesday in an ambush believed to have been staged by separatist militants in Manipur state in northeast India, the United News of India (PTI) said.
The news agency said militants attacked a convoy of five Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) vehicles with sophisticated weapons and bombs at Moijingpok in Manipur near the Burmese border.
Maoist separatists operate in Manipur and there are also occasional clashes between pro-India Kukis and separatist Nagas.
